lead: Peter Dinklage is an American stage actor, born on 11 June 1969 in Morristown.
As of 2026, he is 57 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.

He is associated with work such as Game of Thrones, The Station Agent and X-Men: Days of Future Past and has been recognised with Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series and Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Series, Miniseries or Television Film.
Below you will find a verified overview of Peter Dinklage: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
